newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Manuel to speak on tax collection Tues.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Manuel to speak on tax collection Tues.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel will address a news conference in Cape Town on Tuesday on a new incentive plan to draw potential payers into the tax net, a spokeswoman said.

Finance Ministry spokeswoman Jennifer Wilson said Manuel would address journalists after briefing legislators on the state of the new South African Revenue Services linking former revenue and customs departments.
"It's something like the previous amnesty, but with new provisions aimed at bringing people into the tax net who are not already paying," she said.
South Africa is estimated to be losing at least eight to nine billion rand a year in uncollected taxes.
